card.name: Foot and needle words before a noun
card.fires_on: The word foot (as in footpath, foot-dragging, foot of the tower) or needle, mostly right after "the". It also fires on a few odd spots like "is" after "needle" and "at" before a phone number.

modes.label: foot compounds
modes.description: The word foot starts a compound or phrase such as footpath, foot-washing or foot of a tower.

modes.label: needle in injection text
modes.description: Needle or the word right after it, in blood draw and syringe instructions.
modes.example: Administer immediately to avoid<< needle>> clogging.
